planets.name: Kepler-296 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-296 with a 10.9-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-296 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-296. Its orbit and size follow Barclay et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
